attempts.raw_response: The project was organised by a group of activists who spent months planning the launch, working with weather experts to find the perfect conditions for the flight. They chose a remote location to ensure the balloon could ascend without interference from air traffic or buildings. The pride flag itself was specially made from lightweight, durable nylon to withstand the extreme temperatures and winds of the upper atmosphere. Once the balloon reached its peak altitude, it expanded until it eventually burst, allowing a parachute to carry the equipment safely back to the ground. The team recovered everything intact, including the camera, which had recorded the entire journey from launch to landing. The footage quickly gained attention online, with many praising the creative approach to spreading a message of inclusivity and acceptance far beyond the boundaries of Earth.

pair.human_continuation: The non-profit group said: "The primary purpose of this declaration is to support the ongoing fight for the fundamental human rights of our LGBTQ [Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Queer] family, moving us closer to a universal understanding that all people deserve to live freely and love freely without fear and discrimination." It added that the stunt emphasised the need for the gay community to have a safe space in every corner of the universe. As well as gay rights activism, Planting Peace runs humanitarian aid projects and environmental initiatives across the world. It recently made headlines during the Republican National Convention in Cleveland, Ohio, with a billboard that showed US presidential candidate Donald Trump and then-aspiring Republican nominee Ted Cruz poised to kiss, with the slogan "Love trumps Hate.
pair.prefix: The balloon captured video with a GoPro camera as it floated 21.1 miles (34.1km) above earth for three hours. Organisers said they wanted to declare space gay friendly, "in a peaceful, beautiful way". The balloon and its flag returned to earth, but the episode was captured in striking footage that shows the planet's surface from above, with the sun beaming behind the flag.

source_document.title: Gay pride flag launched into space 'to spread peace'
